bad.s: この二[ふた]つの案[あん]は{千差万別[せんさばんべつ]}だ。
bad.en: (meant: these two plans are completely different)
bad.why: It describes many things that all differ from one another, not a contrast between two. Say ookiku kotonaru.

bad.s: この店[みせ]は品数[しなかず]が{千差万別[せんさばんべつ]}で多[おお]い。
bad.en: (meant: this shop stocks a huge number of items)
bad.why: It is about how things differ, not how many there are. For a wide selection say shinazoroe ga houfu.

mean: of a great many different kinds

use.how: 多種多様なX / Xは多種多様だ: said of a collection that includes many different kinds (products, species, opinions, people), stressing variety and range.

near.diff: 千差万別 stresses that each individual item differs from the next; 多種多様 stresses that the range includes many kinds.
十人十色 is about people each having their own tastes; 多種多様 describes the variety of any collection.

cue: A new food hall puts Thai, Mexican, Turkish, vegan and ramen stalls under one roof. How would its advert describe the dishes on offer?

ctx.s: この店[みせ]には{多種多様[たしゅたよう]}なパンが並[なら]んでいる。
ctx.en: This shop has all kinds of bread on its shelves.

bad.why: It describes many kinds existing together, not one thing changing over time. For weather say kawariyasui.

bad.s: 駐車場[ちゅうしゃじょう]に同[おな]じ車[くるま]が{多種多様[たしゅたよう]}に並[なら]んでいる。

bad.why: It means many different kinds; a large number of identical things is takusan or zurari to.
